title: Peace with God
definition: Peace with God is the reconciled standing believers have through justification by faith in Jesus Christ.
summary: Peace with God is the settled condition of acceptance and reconciliation secured by justification in Christ.
christFocus: Jesus Christ makes peace through His blood and brings believers into restored fellowship with God.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Peace with God is not first a feeling, though it brings comfort. It is the objective result of being justified through faith in Jesus Christ. This doctrine tells the believer that the war caused by sin has ended because Christ has made peace by His blood.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because anxious consciences often confuse emotional turbulence with God's rejection. Peace with God stands on the Gospel even when circumstances are painful. It anchors assurance in what Christ accomplished rather than in a temporary sense of calm.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Return to Romans 5:1 when guilt or fear rises. Pray from the position of peace already given in Christ. Help others distinguish peace with God from mere peaceful feelings.
